title: Torns Enterprises
description:
Vicente Torns is a leading industrial group specializing in the manufacturing of electrical con
ductors for the energy, automotive, and construction sectors. The company transforms copper and
aluminum for use in the electrical sector, offering a wide range of products including encased
strips, twisted cables, and polyimide.
